workflow: Managers combine POS and spreadsheet exports each morning
problem: The daily report arrives after service decisions are made
consequence: Purchasing and staffing adjustments are delayed
text: Our manager combines two exports every morning, so the useful summary often arrives after decisions.

workflow: A group reviews location results manually

workflow: Staff recount and enter inventory in a spreadsheet
problem: Keeping quantities current takes substantial manual work
consequence: The team stops trusting the numbers
